review_cadence: Manual. These are legal texts, not a statistical table, so there is no scheduled fetch. Read the file again each May and November, and sooner when a gazette this file cites publishes a change. A town with no row stays unknown. Do not fill a gap from a news report.
not_legal_advice: This layer is not legal advice and not a determination that any dwelling can or cannot be let. It is a reading of published legal texts, dated on each row. A licence, a community resolution and a planning rule are decided on the building. The gross-yield figure is unchanged.
yield_maths: The short-let yield on a listing is the existing estimate. This file does not change the nightly rate, the occupied weeks, the gross yield, the net yield, or the score.

method.question: For a new buyer of a new-build in this place, do the published rules let the modelled short-let yield be treated as legally available?

risk_levels.high: A published municipal or regional instrument currently refuses new tourist-dwelling authorisations across the place this row covers.
risk_levels.elevated: A published rule conditions a new tourist-use registration on a municipal report, a zoning limit, or another step that is not a pure notification, and no current total freeze was verified.
risk_levels.low: Reserved for a place where the regional regime is a responsible declaration and a municipal instrument was read that adds no further limit. No town in this file met that test.
risk_levels.unknown: The regional regime is recorded, and the municipal instrument was not read, or the place could not be tied to one town hall. Silence is not treated as permission.

method.national_note: Two national rules sit on every town and are not used to push every town to the same level. In a building under the Horizontal Property Act, a new tourist letting needs a prior express community vote of three fifths of the owners and of the shares, from 3 April 2025, with a saving for an owner who was already letting under the tourism rules before that date. A house that is not in a community is outside that Act. The Supreme Court judgment of 19 May 2026 annulled the state single-lease-register procedure and the duty to obtain a Land Registry number in order to advertise. It did not annul the digital one-stop shop, the platforms’ data-sharing duties, or the regional tourism registers.
method.municipal_note: A town is marked unknown when this review did not read a municipal instrument. That is not a finding that the town hall is permissive.

limitations: Municipal gazettes were not read for every town. Where no instrument was read, the row is unknown.

Alicante city’s December 2024 suspension was approved in plenary, and the council’s later notice says it was published in the DOGV on 13 January 2025 and lifts if the plan was not exhibited within a year. That condition was not re-checked, so the city is not marked as a current freeze.

No municipal ordinance was opened for the other Andalusian towns. A web index mentioned a December 2025 Manilva ordinance, and the provincial gazette’s date links did not return that issue, so it is not recorded.

Plan steps after Málaga’s August 2025 suspension were not re-read. The high flag relies on that suspension, which by its own text runs for up to three years from gazette publication or until the plan change is approved.

Districts are tied to a municipality from their ordinary administrative identity. Listings were not checked one by one against the cadastre. La Manga del Mar Menor, La Manga Club and La Marina were left unresolved.
Bilingual and accented official municipality names were not re-checked against the INE code list in this pass.
Community statutes, an existing regional registration, and the planning class of a plot are not in this file. They can allow or block a particular dwelling either way.
The judgment of 19 May 2026 does not remove the regional tourism registers of Andalusia, the Valencian Community or Murcia.

national.title: Community consent under the Horizontal Property Act
national.summary: From 3 April 2025, the owner who wants to use a dwelling in a community for the tourist letting described in article 5(e) of the Urban Leases Act needs the community’s prior express approval. The vote is three fifths of the owners and three fifths of the shares. The same majority can limit, condition or prohibit that activity, and can raise that dwelling’s share of common costs by up to 20 percent. An owner who was already exercising the activity under the tourism rules before 3 April 2025 may continue on those rules. The Act governs horizontal property. A house that is not in a community is outside it.

Ley Orgánica 1/2025, de 2 de enero, BOE-A-2025-76, disposición final que modifica la Ley de propiedad horizontal

national.title: State single register after the Supreme Court judgment of 19 May 2026
national.summary: Royal Decree 1312/2024 created a state single register of short leases and a digital one-stop shop, to apply Regulation (EU) 2024/1028. Judgment 620/2026 of 19 May 2026, published in the BOE on 8 June 2026, upheld part of the Valencian government’s challenge. It annulled the single-register procedure and the duty to register in the Land Registry or the Movable Property Registry in order to obtain a number and advertise a short let on an online platform. It dismissed the rest. The General Council of the Judiciary’s note of 21 May 2026 says the digital one-stop shop, the platforms’ duty to transmit data, and the statistical transmission were not annulled, and that the state lacked competence to lay a national register over the regional tourism registers.

regions.name: Andalusia
regions.summary: Decree 28/2016, as amended by Decree 31/2024 and Decree-law 1/2025, orders viviendas de uso turístico. The operator files a responsible declaration with the regional tourism department and may advertise from that filing. The declaration must say the dwelling is compatible with the planning rules and, where planning law requires it, that a municipal licence or change-of-use declaration is held. The town hall is told of the inscription and can ask for it to be cancelled if the dwelling does not fit its planning rules. Decree-law 1/2025, article 6, lets a municipality that justifies imperative reasons of general interest regulate whether tourist use is compatible with residential use, and, when it starts the planning change, suspend new licences and responsible declarations for up to three years. Where this review did not read such a municipal decision, the town is unknown.

regions.name: Valencian Community
regions.summary: Decree-law 9/2024, validated by the Corts on 5 September 2024, defines a tourist dwelling as a whole dwelling let for ten days or less that has a favourable municipal urban-compatibility report. Letting by the room is not allowed. The inscription lasts five years and renewal needs a fresh report. A change of owner after 8 August 2024 needs a new declaration and that report. Law 3/2026, in force on 3 July 2026, keeps the report and adds a declaration that the Horizontal Property Act’s express community approval was obtained before inscription, with a narrower rule for dwellings already inscribed before Decree-law 9/2024 when they renew. The report requirement is regional, so every Alicante place in the book is at least elevated. A current municipal freeze is marked only where this review verified that it is still in force.

regions.name: Region of Murcia
regions.summary: Decree 256/2019 of 10 October orders tourist dwellings and rooms let as tourist lodging. Before the service starts, the operator files a responsible declaration with the regional tourism institute. A complete filing lets the activity start, without replacing any other licence another authority requires. The decree does not itself impose a municipal compatibility report of the Valencian kind. No municipal ordinance in this province was read, so every Murcia place in the book is unknown.
